notes: The prompt self-declares 'un obby moderno de Roblox' and the giant keys are platforms jumped between at the player's own pace, so Obby & Platformer with its genre-wide P6. Shape is course-flat because the intake answer says the nine zones form one continuous route across the same desk with no teleports between stages, which rules out course-tower and space-staged; the monitor and CPU zones give some vertical gain but nothing in the brief overhangs the route, so no P2 and I did not upgrade to course-terraced. Took Classic Obby and added the options the prompt states outright that the preset lacks: obstacle-timing for the disappearing and sinking keys, hazard-kill for the lasers, electrified cables and stated elimination zones, collectible-nodes for the coins, social-hub for the cosmetics shop at the start, and winner-zone at the CPU since the answers name it as the final escape goal. Without a user I judged the timer and best-time leaderboard, pets, daily rewards, achievements and XP levels to be gameplay and UI rather than layout, so they carry no option and no pipeline cost.
